subject: use same radioButtons multiple times does not work

messages.author: 3b718630a63ab359
messages.subject: use same radioButtons multiple times does not work
parts:
In html, if two radio buttons have the same name, they would work together as a group even they are not placed together. Here I'm trying to call radioButtons multiple times with the same id, but it doesn't work. The purpose is so that I can put some controls inbetween the radio buttons to make the UI more reasonable. But when I do that, the two radio buttions would look like as if they work together (when you select one, the other will be deselected). However, the input$ value of the buttons remains 0 no matter which one is chosen.

Is this a bug? Or are there better ways to achieve this?

Thanks!

messages.author: c6ca7877bef91eef
messages.subject: Re: use same radioButtons multiple times does not work
parts:
Shiny requires every input element to have a UNIQUE id, which is why your current approach is failing.

If the only reason you are using the same id is to create a dependence, a better way to achieve it is to do the following.

1. Set up two radio buttons with different id's.
2. Use updateRadioButtons to update the values of each other such that when one is selected, the other is deselected.
